build_trace_dataset_from_pkl: build a dataset from pkl trace files by running the script with --path and --output-dir arguments
build_react_style_traces: build react style traces from a directory of episodes using the --react flag
process_file_single_trace: process a single pkl file to generate per step txt samples for finetuning a planning model
filter_traces_by_success_rate: filter traces by task completion rate using --percent_cut to only include episodes above a threshold
extract_assistant_text_end: extract end indices of assistant text blocks from LLM prompt content using regex pattern matching
